source.content: public class ApexCorePacketBatch implements Database.Batchable<Object> { public Database.QueryLocator start(Database.BatchableContext bc) { List<Object> rows = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'Batch-One'), new Account(Name = 'Batch-Two')}; return Database.getQueryLocator(rows, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext bc, List<Object> scope) { for (Object item : scope) { Account row = (Account)item; insert new Account(Name = 'Handled-' + row.Name); } } public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) {} }

public class ApexCorePacketSaveCallback implements DataSource.AsyncSaveCallback { public static Integer seen = 0; public void processSave(Database.SaveResult result) { System.assert(result.isSuccess()); seen++; } }

public class ApexCorePacketDeleteCallback implements DataSource.AsyncDeleteCallback { public static Integer seen = 0; public void processDelete(Database.DeleteResult result) { System.assert(result.isSuccess()); seen++; } }

@isTest private class ApexCorePacketSupportedFixtureTest { @isTest static void provesLocalPacketRows() { System.assert(AccessType.values().size() >= 4); System.assert(CallbackStatus.values().size() > 0); System.assert(CustomizationType.values().size() > 0); System.assert(DomainType.values().size() > 0); System.assert(JSONToken.values().size() > 0); System.assert(LoggingLevel.values().size() >= 8); System.assert(OrgMetricPublishTypeEnum.values().size() > 0); System.assert(OrgMetricServiceEnum.values().size() > 0); System.assert(OrgMetricTypeEnum.values().size() > 0); System.assert(ParentJobResult.values().size() > 0); System.assert(Quiddity.values().size() > 0); System.assert(RoundingMode.values().size() >= 8); System.assert(SetupScope.values().size() > 0); System.assert(StatusCode.values().size() > 0); System.assert(TriggerOperation.values().size() >= 7); System.assert(XmlTag.values().size() > 0); Account vf = new Account(Name = 'VF'); ApexPages.StandardController controller = new ApexPages.StandardController(vf); System.assertEquals(null, controller.getId()); vf.Id = '001000000000001AAA'; System.assertEquals('001000000000001AAA', controller.getId()); ApexPages.StandardSetController setController = new ApexPages.StandardSetController(new List<Account>{vf, new Account(Name = 'Second')}); System.assertEquals(0, setController.getListViewOptions().size()); setController.setSelected(new List<Account>{vf}); System.assertEquals(1, setController.getSelected().size()); ApexPages.IdeaStandardSetController ideaController = new ApexPages.IdeaStandardSetController(); System.assertEquals(0, ideaController.getListViewOptions().size()); Knowledge__kav article = new Knowledge__kav(Title = 'Local article'); ApexPages.KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController knowledge = new ApexPages.KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController(article); System.assertEquals(article, knowledge.getRecord()); List<Object> rows = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'Locator-One')}; Database.QueryLocator locator = Database.getQueryLocator(rows); Object iterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); Account located = (Account)iterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Locator-One', located.Name); List<Object> accessRows = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'Locator-Two')}; Object accessIterator = Database.getQueryLocator(accessRows, AccessLevel.USER_MODE).iterator(); System.assert(accessIterator.hasNext()); Test.startTest(); Database.executeBatch(new ApexCorePacketBatch(), 1); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Handled-Batch-One']); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Handled-Batch-Two']); ApexCorePacketSaveCallback saveCallback = new ApexCorePacketSaveCallback(); List<Object> inserts = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'Async-One'), new Account(Name = 'Async-Two')}; List<Database.SaveResult> insertResults = Database.insertAsync(inserts, saveCallback); System.assertEquals(2, insertResults.size()); Database.SaveResult singleInsert = Database.insertAsync(new Account(Name = 'Async-Three'), saveCallback, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assert(singleInsert.isSuccess()); List<Object> plainInsert = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'Async-Plain')}; System.assertEquals(1, Database.insertAsync(plainInsert).size()); List<Object> updates = new List<Object>{new Account(Id = insertResults[0].getId(), Name = 'Async-One-Updated')}; System.assertEquals(1, Database.updateAsync(updates).size()); List<Object> callbackUpdates = new List<Object>{new Account(Id = insertResults[1].getId(), Name = 'Async-Two-Updated')}; System.assertEquals(1, Database.updateAsync(callbackUpdates, saveCallback).size()); List<Object> accessUpdates = new List<Object>{new Account(Id = singleInsert.getId(), Name = 'Async-Three-Updated')}; System.assertEquals(1, Database.updateAsync(accessUpdates, saveCallback, AccessLevel.USER_MODE).size()); ApexCorePacketDeleteCallback deleteCallback = new ApexCorePacketDeleteCallback(); System.assertEquals(1, Database.deleteAsync(updates).size()); System.assertEquals(1, Database.deleteAsync(callbackUpdates, deleteCallback).size()); System.assertEquals(1, Database.deleteAsync(accessUpdates, deleteCallback, AccessLevel.USER_MODE).size()); System.assert(ApexCorePacketSaveCallback.seen >= 4); System.assert(ApexCorePacketDeleteCallback.seen >= 2); } }
